ALTER PROC [dbo].[sp_locationHosts_status] (@pjsonfile VARCHAR(MAX))
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    DECLARE @Outputmessage NVARCHAR(MAX) = '{
      "result": [
        { "value": "", "msg": "", "error": "" }
      ]
    }';

    DECLARE @locationHostId INT;
    DECLARE @companyId INT;
    DECLARE @newStatus NVARCHAR(20);
    DECLARE @newStaffNotes NVARCHAR(500);

    SELECT TOP 1
        @locationHostId = TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.locationHostId')),
        @companyId = TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.companyId')),
        @newStatus = JSON_VALUE(value, '$.status'),
        @newStaffNotes = JSON_VALUE(value, '$.staffNotes')
    FROM OPENJSON(@pjsonfile, '$.locationHosts');

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.locationHosts WHERE locationHostId = @locationHostId AND companyId = @companyId)
        BEGIN
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Location host not found or does not belong to the specified company.');
            GOTO Finish;
        END;

        UPDATE dbo.locationHosts
        SET
            status = ISNULL(@newStatus, status), -- Only update if newStatus is provided
            staffNotes = @newStaffNotes,         -- NULL in payload means clear notes
            updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME()
        WHERE locationHostId = @locationHostId AND companyId = @companyId;

        SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].value', CAST(@locationHostId AS NVARCHAR(MAX)));
        SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Status and notes updated successfully.');

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
        SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', ERROR_MESSAGE());
    END CATCH;

Finish:
    SELECT
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.value') AS value,
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.msg')   AS msg,
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.error') AS error
    FROM OPENJSON(@Outputmessage,'$.result');
END;

GO", "sp_all": "ALTER PROC [dbo].[sp_locationHosts_all] (@pjsonfile VARCHAR(MAX))
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN
    DECLARE @companyId INT;
    DECLARE @statusFilter NVARCHAR(20);
    DECLARE @zoneNameFilter NVARCHAR(120);
    DECLARE @startDate DATETIME;
    DECLARE @endDate DATETIME;

    SELECT TOP 1
        @companyId = TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.companyId')),
        @statusFilter = JSON_VALUE(value, '$.status'),
        @zoneNameFilter = JSON_VALUE(value, '$.zoneName'),
        @startDate = TRY_CONVERT(DATETIME, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.startDate')),
        @endDate = TRY_CONVERT(DATETIME, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.endDate'))
    FROM OPENJSON(@pjsonfile, '$.locationHosts');

    -- Apply default date range if not provided (last 90 days in Hermosillo time, UTC-7)
    IF @endDate IS NULL
        SET @endDate = DATEADD(HOUR, -7, SYSUTCDATETIME()); -- Current Hermosillo date (UTC-7)
    IF @startDate IS NULL
        SET @startDate = DATEADD(DAY, -90, @endDate); -- 90 days before current Hermosillo date (UTC-7)

    SELECT
        [locationHostId],
        ISNULL([companyId], 0) AS companyId,
        ISNULL([channelId], 0) AS channelId,
        ISNULL([contactPhone], '') AS contactPhone,
        ISNULL([marketingLeadAttributionId], 0) AS marketingLeadAttributionId,
        ISNULL([origin], '') AS origin,
        ISNULL([businessName], '') AS businessName,
        ISNULL([businessType], '') AS businessType,
        ISNULL([contactName], '') AS contactName,
        ISNULL([contactRole], '') AS contactRole,
        ISNULL([zoneText], '') AS zoneText,
        ISNULL([addressText], '') AS addressText,
        ISNULL([zoneName], '') AS zoneName,
        ISNULL([zoneLat], 0.0) AS zoneLat,
        ISNULL([zoneLng], 0.0) AS zoneLng,
        ISNULL([openingHours], '') AS openingHours,
        ISNULL([opensWeekends], 0) AS opensWeekends,
        ISNULL([spaceType], '') AS spaceType,
        ISNULL([dailyVisitors], '') AS dailyVisitors,
        ISNULL([hasParking], 0) AS hasParking,
        ISNULL([contactOptIn], 0) AS contactOptIn,
        ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), [optInAt], 126), '') AS optInAt,
        ISNULL([status], '') AS status,
        ISNULL([staffNotes], '') AS staffNotes,
        CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), [created_At], 126) AS created_At,
        ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), updated_at, 126), '') AS updated_at
    FROM dbo.locationHosts
    WHERE
        companyId = @companyId
        AND (@statusFilter IS NULL OR status = @statusFilter)
        AND (@zoneNameFilter IS NULL OR zoneName = @zoneNameFilter)
        -- Convert created_At (UTC) to Hermosillo time (UTC-7) for comparison with Hermosillo date filters
        AND CAST(DATEADD(HOUR, -7, created_At) AS DATE) >= CAST(@startDate AS DATE)
        AND CAST(DATEADD(HOUR, -7, created_At) AS DATE) <= CAST(@endDate AS DATE)
    ORDER BY created_At DESC
    FOR JSON AUTO, ROOT('locationHosts');
END;
